title: Parliament approves creation of national cybersecurity agency to combat rising cyber threats
author: Christabel Adhiambo
body: Lawmakers have approved the establishment of a dedicated national cybersecurity agency, responding to a rise in threats facing government and private-sector systems. The Computer Society of Kenya has welcomed the move as a step toward stronger digital resilience nationally.

title: Register for the 17th Annual ICT Management and Leadership Conference
author: Computer Society of Kenya
body: Registration is open for the 17th Annual ICT Management and Leadership Conference, running 26–30 October at Travellers Beach Hotel, Mombasa.
